verdalis.title: The Verdalis suite
verdalis.text: Nine instruments for the sounds of the world, one that layers them into whole scenes, and one for the hits and whooshes a production needs. Every sound is computed while it plays — nothing is sampled, nothing loops, and no two takes are alike.

other.title: Beyond nature
other.text: Machines, effects and experiments that don't belong in a forest: an acid bass box, a drum machine, a reverb, a kick designer, a drawing effects rack and a whole home computer.

plugins.name: RainyDay
plugins.card: From a single cave drip to a tropical monsoon.
plugins.intro: A single drip in a cave, a drizzle on the window, a downpour on a tin roof or a monsoon in the jungle — close by or across the yard. Every drop is synthesised the moment it lands, so the rain never repeats and has no loop point.

highlights.title: Any surface
highlights.text: Water, leaves, metal, glass, stone or a car roof — each one rings and splashes differently.

highlights.title: Near or far
highlights.text: Move the rain from right above your head to a distant wall of water across the valley.

highlights.title: Never loops
highlights.text: Hold a note for an hour and you still won't hear the same drop twice.

images.alt: The RainyDay plugin window with knob panels for rain, distance, envelope, filter, space, close drops and trickle.

spotlight.title: Rain
spotlight.description: A track by Henry Solberg, made with one of the very first versions of RainyDay.

plugins.name: ThunderClap
plugins.tagline: Thunder, from the lightning bolt outwards.
plugins.card: A sharp crack overhead or a storm rolling past.
plugins.intro: Each flash grows its own lightning channel, so every strike sounds different — a tearing crack right above you, a long roll bouncing between the hills, or a whole storm passing while you hold a note.

highlights.title: Every bolt is unique
highlights.text: The shape of the lightning decides the sound, and no two bolts are shaped alike.

highlights.title: Distance is a knob
highlights.text: From the crack next door to a murmur twenty kilometres away.

highlights.title: Whole storms
highlights.text: Hold a key and flashes come and go on their own, near and far.

images.alt: The ThunderClap plugin window in lightning violet.

plugins.name: ShoreBreak
plugins.card: Waves breaking on sand, pebbles or rock.
plugins.intro: Waves break, foam hisses, water washes back over sand, pebbles or rock — from a calm murmur far out to big waves crashing right in front of you. Hold a note and the sea keeps coming in.

highlights.title: Every part of a wave
highlights.text: The break, the foam, the bubbles and the water running back down the beach.

highlights.title: Calm to stormy
highlights.text: Gentle laps in a harbour or a shore in uproar.

highlights.title: Endless tide
highlights.text: No two waves arrive quite the same.

images.alt: The ShoreBreak plugin window in sea green.

plugins.name: SkyHowl
plugins.tagline: Wind with one knob that matters.
plugins.card: From a soft breath to a howling gale.
plugins.intro: Turn up the wind speed and it goes from a soft breath at the window to a gale over a ridge, howling through gaps and rustling the trees as it goes. Cave mouths, city streets, dunes and open plains included.

highlights.title: Speed is everything
highlights.text: One control takes you from a breeze to a storm — the gusts, the howl and the rustle all follow.

highlights.title: Places, not just wind
highlights.text: Pines, birches, reeds, a wire fence, a cave, a street between houses.

highlights.title: Real howls
highlights.text: The pitch swoops up as a gust arrives and falls away with it.

images.alt: The SkyHowl plugin window in dust coral.

plugins.name: ChirpParade
plugins.card: One bird per key, or a whole dawn chorus.
plugins.intro: Ten kinds of bird, built from the shapes of real syllables, so a phrase never comes out the same way twice. Play one bird per note like an instrument, or hold a key and let a whole flock chatter on its own.

highlights.title: Ten voices
highlights.text: Blackbird, robin, nightingale, cuckoo, geese, woodpeckers, parakeets and more.

highlights.title: Play a tune
highlights.text: Melody Bird follows your keyboard — and sings higher the harder you play.

highlights.title: Living flocks
highlights.text: Birds answer each other across the field, near and far.

images.alt: The ChirpParade plugin window in finch gold.

plugins.name: RiverFlow
plugins.tagline: From roaring falls to a tickling little creek.
plugins.intro: Loud, noisy rivers and waterfalls, or a bubbly little creek dabbling between the stones. Drops splash onto wet rock, a roar builds in the distance — and since the river is generated as it plays, it never loops.

highlights.title: Bubbles you can count
highlights.text: Close up, you hear every pocket of air folding through the water.

highlights.title: Small to huge
highlights.text: A single drip off an overhang or a big fall crashing into its pool.

highlights.title: Real places
highlights.text: Gorges, culverts, glaciers and forest streams, each with their own space.

images.alt: The RiverFlow plugin window in river green.

plugins.name: CrackleBlaze
plugins.card: A cosy hearth, a campfire or a burning roof.
plugins.intro: A small fire in a cottage hearth, a campfire under the stars, or a building alight across the street. Crackles, hissing damp wood and settling logs over the roar of the flames — never the same twice.

highlights.title: Crackle, hiss and roar
highlights.text: Dry sticks snapping, wet wood steaming, logs collapsing into the embers.

highlights.title: Any fireplace
highlights.text: Open fires, wood stoves, a sauna stove or a furnace.

highlights.title: Burns forever
highlights.text: The fire keeps changing for as long as you hold the note.

images.alt: The CrackleBlaze plugin window in ember orange.

plugins.name: InsectSwarm
plugins.tagline: One bee at the window, or the whole hive.
plugins.card: Bees, wasps, flies, mosquitoes and cicadas.
plugins.intro: Insects in any number — a single bee, a hive, wasps around the picnic table, flies against the glass, a mosquito that won't leave, dragonflies, cicadas and crickets. Every wingbeat is synthesised, so the swarm moves and breathes like the real thing.

highlights.title: They fly around you
highlights.text: Insects come close, back off and circle your head.

highlights.title: From one to forty-eight
highlights.text: A single bee or a hive so busy it turns into a roar.

highlights.title: Wings and songs
highlights.text: Buzzing wings, singing cicadas and chirping crickets.

images.alt: The InsectSwarm plugin window in wasp yellow.

plugins.name: NightLife
plugins.tagline: A whole night, not a recording of one.
plugins.card: Wolves, owls, foxes, frogs and crickets.
plugins.intro: Wolves howling across a valley, owls in the wood, a fox in the field, a loon over the lake, a pond full of frogs and crickets everywhere. It runs for as long as you hold the note and never repeats.

highlights.title: The night shift
highlights.text: Wolves, owls, foxes, loons, frogs and crickets — together or one by one.

highlights.title: They answer each other
highlights.text: A pack builds up its howl, a second owl replies from further off.

highlights.title: A bed to build on
highlights.text: The breathing darkness of a forest at night, ready for anything on top.

images.alt: The NightLife plugin window in moonlight blue.

plugins.name: VerdaliScene
plugins.tagline: All of nature in one plugin.
plugins.card: Layer the nine instruments into whole scenes.
plugins.intro: Stack rain, thunder, surf, wind, birds, rivers, fire, insects and night animals as layers, mix them, add reverb and delay, and build a whole place — a forest river, a stormy shore, a winter cabin. Your presets from the single plugins load straight into its layers.

highlights.title: Nine instruments, one window
highlights.text: Every layer is the full plugin, with all of its presets.

highlights.title: A mixer for nature
highlights.text: Balance, pan, mute and solo every layer like tracks in a song.

highlights.title: Effects on every layer
highlights.text: Reverb, delay and more per layer and on the whole scene.

images.alt: VerdaliScene's scene page: a channel strip for every layer of the Forest River scene.
A VerdaliScene layer page: the full ChirpParade panel playing the scene's cuckoo.
VerdaliScene's effects page: a reverb, a delay and five more effects on one layer.

plugins.name: WhooshPact
plugins.intro: Not nature, but the sounds a production needs — whooshes, impacts, booms, braams, downshifters and stings. Each hit is synthesised fresh, so a cut full of transitions doesn't sound like the same sample twenty times.

highlights.title: Six families
highlights.text: Transitions, impacts, booms, braams, downshifters and accents.

highlights.title: Never the same twice
highlights.text: Every hit comes out a little different, unless you want it identical.

highlights.title: Built for picture
highlights.text: Trailers, games, podcasts and videos — anything that needs a cut to land.

images.alt: The WhooshPact plugin window in impact magenta.

plugins.name: SäureKiste
plugins.card: A squelching acid bass box, circuit by circuit.
plugins.intro: A monophonic acid bass synthesiser, modelled circuit by circuit on a well-known little silver box: the squelching filter, the accent that bites, the slides that glide instead of retriggering. Write lines in its own sequencer or play it from your DAW — then push it through ten drive models and an effects chain.

highlights.title: The real squelch
highlights.text: Filter, accent and slide behave like the original circuit, down to the quirks.

highlights.title: Sequencer built in
highlights.text: 64 patterns, a pattern generator, a live mode and MIDI import and export.

highlights.title: Then push it
highlights.text: An advanced mode, ten drive models, delay and a full effects chain.

images.alt: The SäureKiste plugin window: acid-green knob panels above a piano-roll sequencer and a bank of 64 patterns.
SäureKiste with its advanced section open: unison, filter modulation, slide, vibrato and fine-tuning.
SäureKiste's effects page with a saturator, a filter and a reverb in the chain.

plugins.name: RumpelKiste
plugins.tagline: The classic drum machine, rebuilt as circuits.
plugins.card: A legendary drum machine with sequencer and drive.
plugins.intro: A rhythm composer modelled on a legendary drum machine's voice board — kick, snare, toms, rim shot and clap built as circuits, the cymbals through the original's gritty six-bit path. Program it in its 64-pattern step sequencer, or play it from your DAW, and send the whole kit through a drive bus.

highlights.title: Eleven voices
highlights.text: The punchy kick, the snappy snare, toms, rim, clap, hats, crash and ride.

highlights.title: Step sequencer
highlights.text: Accents, flams, shuffle, 64 patterns and a groove generator.

highlights.title: Drive bus
highlights.text: Ten distortion models for the whole kit or just the drums you choose.

images.alt: The RumpelKiste plugin window with drum voice panels and the step sequencer.

plugins.notice: RumpelKiste is an independent project and not affiliated with or endorsed by any hardware or software manufacturer. All trademarks belong to their owners.

plugins.name: Aurum
plugins.tagline: A reverb you can shape by frequency.
plugins.card: Rooms, halls, plates and endless spaces.
plugins.intro: An algorithmic reverb with three engines — a natural room, a classic digital ring and a plate — and eleven spaces from a tight ambience to a ten-second cathedral. Draw how long each frequency rings, tone the result, and freeze it into an endless pad.

highlights.title: Three characters
highlights.text: Natural, Classic and Plate, from realistic rooms to vintage shimmer.

highlights.title: Decay you can draw
highlights.text: Let the lows die fast and the highs ring on — or the other way round.

highlights.title: Learns from real rooms
highlights.text: Import an impulse response and Aurum sets itself up to match the space.

images.alt: The Aurum reverb window with the room ruler, decay contour and tone curve.

plugins.name: Substrike
plugins.tagline: Every kick, from the first thump to the last rumble.
plugins.card: A kick drum designer for every style.
plugins.intro: A kick drum designer that builds every kick from scratch: the soft thud of deep house, a dusty hip-hop knock, a long tuned sub, the overdriven brick of hard techno with its rumble floor, the zap of hardstyle or the buzzing wall of gabber — or something that was never a kick before.

highlights.title: Eight layers
highlights.text: Body, click, noise, resonator and rumble, each with its own effect chain.

highlights.title: Over a hundred presets
highlights.text: Eighteen styles, a browser that plays as you click.

highlights.title: Drag and drop
highlights.text: Pull the finished hit straight into your arrangement as audio.

images.alt: The Substrike window with its layer lanes, pitch envelope and effect chains.

plugins.name: Shapeau
plugins.tagline: Draw the shape, hear it on the beat.
plugins.card: An effects rack you draw, locked to the beat.
plugins.intro: An effects rack you draw. Every effect follows a shape drawn across a bar, a beat or a sixteenth, locked to your host's tempo: a dip is sidechain ducking, a slope is a filter sweep, a few steps make a trance gate. Three frequency bands, each with its own shapes — and you see the audio behind every line you draw.

highlights.title: Seven effects
highlights.text: Volume, filter, drive, crush, stutter, width and pan, in any order.

highlights.title: Per band
highlights.text: Duck the bass, chop the mids and leave the hats alone.

highlights.title: See what you hear
highlights.text: The incoming and outgoing audio is drawn right behind the shape.

images.alt: The Shapeau window: a duck drawn on the low band, over the waveform of the drum loop it ducks.
Shapeau with a chain of three effects in its effect bar.
Shapeau's filter shape: a cutoff sweep drawn on the mid band.
A duck started by the kick drum in the sidechain, drawn in amber.

plugins.name: ReSIDent
plugins.tagline: Original C64 MIDI software, live in your DAW.
plugins.card: A Commodore 64 running its classic synth programs.
plugins.intro: In the eighties people turned the Commodore 64 and its SID chip into synthesizers you played from a MIDI keyboard. ReSIDent is a C64 inside a plugin that runs those programs exactly as they are: notes go in through an emulated MIDI cartridge, the program plays the SID, and the SID plays into your track.

highlights.title: The real programs
highlights.text: Load Cynthcart, SID Synth, Station64 and friends — unmodified, from disk or cartridge.

highlights.title: Up to eight SIDs
highlights.text: 6581 or 8580, each with its own filter, level, pan and output.

highlights.title: Play the machine
highlights.text: Type on its keyboard, use a joystick, and automate its controllers from your DAW.

images.alt: The ReSIDent window running Cynthcart: a Commodore 64 screen with the synthesizer's settings.
